note: The CSV is an audit index, not a generator plan. Exact regeneration requires the external frozen full plan, exact report-matched published embeddings, pinned model weights and source parents. No reports, demographics, embeddings, waveforms or checkpoints are distributed here.

candidate_index_fields.accepted: 1 if accepted by frozen measurement/quality policy; 0 otherwise
candidate_index_fields.snapshot_prefix: 1 for slots 0 through 3379; snapshot uses only their accepted rows

allocation.parent_choice_rule: Round-robin lexicographically sorted strata. Within stratum minimize (record uses, subject uses, exact-report uses, SHA256(diffusets-allocation|0|record_id)).
allocation.report_cluster_rule: Lexical descriptions only, priority pacing, atrial irregularity, slow rate, fast rate, sinus, other. Clusters describe conditioning text and never establish generated answers.
allocation.seed_rule: First four bytes big-endian SHA256(diffusets-candidate|0|slot_id|record_id), increment modulo 2**32 only on collision.
allocation.source_report_rule: Exact source report with age and sex unchanged; PTB-XL sex 0 maps M, 1 maps F. Exclude missing/unsupported demographics and exact noninformative trace-only report.
allocation.target_heart_rate_rule: Use each source waveform measured heart_rate_bpm unchanged; do not invent rates that contradict the preserved report.

published_embeddings.provenance: Published vectors matched to exact source report, age and sex; legacy embedding API input provenance is unknown. No new embedding API calls were used.
